compiled_state.title: Fix _apply_mutation_to_snapshot helper to use Mutation dataclass API (26de DD remediation)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Context
Story 26de verifier P1=FAIL on the matrix-test DD. Production code
(differ + ProvenanceLedger + conflict_resolver) is correct and verified
by other PASS DDs; only the test harness helper in
tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance_matrix.py
lines 68-83 is defective.

The helper `_apply_mutation_to_snapshot()` accesses Mutation objects
via dict-subscript (`mutation['key']`, `mutation['action']`,
`mutation['fields']`), but `differ.compute_mutations()` returns
Mutation **dataclass instances** with attributes `.target`,
`.action.value`, and `.payload`. This TypeError kills 16 bidirectional
+ 4 counter-edit tests (20 of 23).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] _apply_mutation_to_snapshot uses mutation.target / mutation.action.value
      / dict(mutation.payload) — no dict subscript access on Mutation
- [ ] python3 -m pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance_matrix.py
      exits 0 (or only 2 RED-marked deferred tests remain failing)
- [ ] Ruff clean on the test file
- [ ] No production code changes (production verified by other DDs)

## File Impact
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance_matrix.py — Edit (helper only)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
